name: What is the typical process for a siding replacement project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a siding replacement project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The siding replacement process typically begins with an initial consultation and estimate, followed by material selection and project scheduling. On project day, the existing siding is removed, and any underlying damage to the sheathing or insulation is repaired. New house wrap is installed to protect against moisture, followed by the installation of the chosen siding material. Finally, trim and finishing touches are added, and a thorough cleanup is performed. Hometelligent Inc. ensures that all steps, from initial assessment to final inspection, are communicated clearly with homeowners in Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Dublin, or Emeryville.
acceptedAnswer.description: Process includes consultation, material selection, old siding removal, repairs, house wrap, new siding installation, and cleanup. Communication is key.
